value.rationale: Exact adversarial resilience for a canonical infinite family supplies an optimal unrestricted FO^3 stability guarantee. The bottleneck shifts between three geometrically distinct pair patterns; even for arbitrarily large triangular graphs only four witness deletions suffice to destroy the three-variable random-graph theory, while fixed larger uniformity yields asymptotic order n^(r-2). This is a motivated robustness classification, not an arbitrary finite slice.
